name: telegram_notifier
description: Sends text messages, alerts, and Markdown/HTML notifications to Telegram chats or channels via Telegram Bot API.

message.description: The text message content to send to Telegram (supports Markdown or HTML formatting)

chat_id.description: Target Telegram Chat ID or Channel username (e.g., '@mychannel' or '123456789'). Reads TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var if omitted.

bot_token.description: Telegram Bot Token from @BotFather. Reads TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var if omitted.

parse_mode.description: Message formatting mode ('Markdown', 'MarkdownV2', or 'HTML'). Defaults to 'Markdown'.

disable_web_page_preview.description: Whether to disable link previews in the sent message (default false).
